test_cases.name: happy_path_event_append_and_projection
test_cases.description: Standard operational action generates an event envelope, calculates SHA-256 integrity hash, passes optimistic concurrency check, appends to stream, and updates state projection cleanly.
test_cases.input: Record file creation src/main.py in stream workspace:ws-01 with expected_version: 0.

test_cases.name: deterministic_replay_time_travel
test_cases.description: Reconstruct system state up to sequence 1 from baseline on-demand, verifying reproducible state.
test_cases.input: Execute replay on stream workspace:ws-01 with target_seq: 1.

test_cases.name: optimistic_concurrency_conflict_rejection
test_cases.description: Attempt to append event with expected_version different from current_seq is rejected with OPTIMISTIC_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT.
test_cases.input: Propose event for workspace:ws-01 with expected_version: 0 when current_seq is 1.

test_cases.name: event_mutation_forbidden_defect
test_cases.description: Any update or deletion attempt against historical event log halts execution immediately with EVENT_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN.
test_cases.input: Attempt in-place overwrite of historical event record sequence 1 in workspace:ws-01.
expected_output_patterns: Historical event record altered or corrupted

test_cases.name: sequence_gap_detected_defect
test_cases.description: Attempt to append event with sequence gap or non-contiguous sequence is rejected with SEQUENCE_GAP_DETECTED.
test_cases.input: Append event with sequence 3 when current_seq is 1 in stream workspace:ws-01.

test_cases.name: projection_fold_failure_defect
test_cases.description: Exception during projection handler execution transitions system to FAULTED state with PROJECTION_FOLD_FAILURE.
test_cases.input: Execute projection fold where handler throws unhandled exception for event payload.

test_cases.name: schema_validation_error_defect
test_cases.description: Event with invalid payload schema or missing required fields halts append with SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR.
test_cases.input: Propose event with missing required metadata fields or malformed payload schema.

test_cases.name: integrity_hash_mismatch_defect
test_cases.description: Replay detects corrupted event envelope whose computed SHA-256 hash does not match integrity_hash.
test_cases.input: Execute replay on stream workspace:ws-01 where event record 2 has modified payload bytes.
